frame_convention.T_tcp_from_gripper_contact_center: Transform from gripper contact-center frame to the modeled TCP frame.
frame_convention.contact_offset_tcp_m: Translation from modeled TCP origin to gripper contact center, expressed in the modeled TCP frame.

notes: The arm reached the planned pre_grasp TCP within 0.78 mm before this estimate.
The estimate is intentionally recorded as provisional because the contact center was partly occluded in the head-mounted RealSense view.
Use for no-motion IK validation first; do not treat as final hardware calibration without repeated validation.
